plan.vision: A specialized agent designed to flag and categorize AI-generated content on Hacker News (HN) to enhance content integrity. The agent will use natural language processing (NLP) techniques to analyze and classify articles, providing a clear indicator for users to skip AI-generated text if they choose. The project will be developed in a modular, test-driven manner, ensuring robustness and maintainability.

hn_content_fetcher.py.fetch_hn_articles(): Fetches the latest articles from HN and returns them as a list of dictionaries.

ai_detection_model.py.train_model(training_data): Trains the NLP model using the provided training data.
ai_detection_model.py.predict(text): Predicts whether the given text is AI-generated and returns a boolean.

content_flagger.py.flag_ai_generated_content(articles, ai_d: Flags AI-generated content in the provided list of articles using the AI detection model.

plan.lessons_learned: This project avoids past mistakes by using memory-mapped files for efficient data handling, prioritizing algorithmic efficiency over OOP overhead, and ensuring that all dependencies are pinned in a virtual environment. The repository will be kept lightweight by excluding heavy directories with .gitignore, and clear setup scripts will be provided for reproducibility. Additionally, the project will focus on security and isolation, ensuring that the code executed within the sandbox cannot access or modify external resources. There are no hidden paid-API dependencies.
plan.commit_message: Implemented a specialized agent to detect and flag AI-generated content on Hacker News.

files_to_generate.instructions: Implement a function `fetch_hn_articles()` that fetches the latest articles from Hacker News and returns them as a list of dictionaries. Each dictionary should contain the title, URL, and text of the article.

Implement functions `train_model(training_data)` and `predict(text)`. The `train_model` function should train an NLP model using the provided training data, and the `predict` function should predict whether the given text is AI-generated and return a boolean.

Implement a function `flag_ai_generated_content(articles, ai_detection_model)` that flags AI-generated content in the provided list of articles using the AI detection model. The function should update the articles list with a new key `is_ai_generated` set to True or False based on the prediction.

Write a comprehensive unit test suite that imports and uses the actual generated modules. Test the `fetch_hn_articles`, `train_model`, `predict`, and `flag_ai_generated_content` functions. Ensure that the tests cover all edge cases and that the core logic can be tested without complex mocks.
Create a .gitignore file to ignore venv, __pycache__, and .env files.
Write a README.md explaining the architecture, how to set up the project, and how to run the tests. Include a section on the design decisions and the testing strategy.
